module: Selection query of the Easy Object Select tool. From the mouse position and the camera, it collects the scene objects (StaticShape, StaticObject, vehicles) under or near the cursor, resolves them to their owning prefab, applies the filters (class, hidden, locked, bounds, name patterns, max volume and distance) and builds "proxies" (screen geometry) classified as "over" (cursor on top) or "discovery" (within the discovery radius) relation. Uses the selectionCache cache when available, otherwise a "broad" mode (screen rectangle + box around the camera).
notes: Classes excluded outright: TerrainBlock, WaterPlane, Forest; the object named gameCamera is ignored.

The namePattern / ignorePattern patterns are comma-separated lists of Lua patterns (string.find), tested against the name, the internal name, the shapeName field and the model file. An invalid pattern causes all objects to be rejected (rejected.invalidPattern / invalidIgnorePattern).
Broad query radius: max(discoveryPixels + 8, 128 * uiscale); default near distance 40 m (nearQueryDistance); default discoveryPixels 48.

Rejection reasons are counted in the rejected table (unsupported, excludedClass, cameraObject, hidden, classDisabled, locked, selectionDisabled, invalidBounds, patternFilter, ignorePattern, outsideVolume, outsideRange, outsideDiscovery...).
Local function passesPatterns defined but not used in this file.

gather.desc: Collects the selection candidates for the current frame. Returns nil if the camera context is unavailable. Fills proxies (over relation), discoveryProxies (discovery relation), filteredLarge (large filtered objects if options.collectFilteredLarge), queryStats, rejected and sourceCount.

options.desc: discoveryPixels (px, default 48), nearQueryDistance (m, default 40), maxDistance (m), maxVolume (m^3), namePattern, ignorePattern (comma-separated lists of Lua patterns), collectFilteredLarge (boolean).

returns.desc: Table {camera, mouse, queryRadius, discoveryRadius, nearQueryDistance, proxies, discoveryProxies, filteredLarge, queryStats, rejected, sourceCount}.

activate.desc: Enables the selection cache (selectionCache.activate). Called when the tool opens.

getCacheStatus.desc: Returns the state of the selection cache (selectionCache.getStatus), useful for the debug display.

validatePatternList.desc: Checks that a comma-separated list of Lua patterns is valid (each entry is tested with pcall(string.find)).

returns.desc: true if all patterns are valid.
